title: Cost is an architecture property
points: Workload demand drives compute, storage and network usage; preserve performance and resilience while optimizing cost.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Savings Plans versus Reserved Instances
points: Decision comparison: Compute Savings Plans flexible across EC2, Fargate and Lambda; EC2 Instance Savings Plans tied to family and Region; RIs tied to instance attributes; capacity reservation is a separate capacity decision.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Capacity is not a discount
points: Show two separate layers: pricing commitment and capacity assurance. Savings Plans reduce eligible usage rates but do not reserve EC2 capacity; On-Demand Capacity Reservation protects capacity independently.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Spot belongs behind interruption handling
points: Spot worker fleet handles retryable queue jobs with checkpoints and diversified capacity; interruption signal drains work; stable baseline stays on committed or On-Demand capacity.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Rightsize before committing
points: Performance metrics, memory and CPU observations, Compute Optimizer recommendation, load test, reduce idle capacity, then commit remaining steady baseline. Show iterative feedback.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Scale for the shape of demand
points: Contrast target tracking for variable load, scheduled scaling for predictable peaks, and minimum capacity for availability. Diagram peak and trough with capacity curve.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Choose compute by work pattern
points: Compare EC2 long-running control, Fargate container operations, Lambda event-driven duration, Step Functions Standard durable orchestration and Express high-volume short workflows. Mention fit and billing dimensions.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: AI inference cost follows tokens and traffic
points: Show prompt and output tokens, model tier, batching, caching, provisioned throughput decision. Use a request flow with cache hit path and model invocation path; preserve quality and latency.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Content delivery reduces origin work
points: CloudFront edge cache and Origin Shield: hit avoids repeat origin transfer and processing; cache key and TTL decide hit ratio; failover path uses secondary origin. Diagram viewer to edge to shield to origins.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Trace the network bill
points: Map same-AZ, cross-AZ, cross-Region, internet egress, NAT Gateway processing, Transit Gateway processing and PrivateLink endpoint charges as separate metered boundaries. Avoid numeric rates.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Keep AZ-aware flows deliberate
points: Compare app and database same AZ for avoidable transfer with multi-AZ availability requirement; show failure-safe topology and cross-AZ transfer where resilience requires it.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: NAT Gateway or VPC endpoint?
points: Private subnet reaches S3 or service via gateway/interface endpoint versus NAT Gateway internet path; show endpoint hourly/data processing considerations and routing; select by service and traffic.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Transit Gateway and PrivateLink cost boundaries
points: TGW attachment plus processing for routed many-VPC paths; PrivateLink endpoint hourly plus processing for service consumption. Diagram flows, ownership and cost meter at each boundary.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Replicate only what recovery requires
points: S3 cross-Region replication and DynamoDB global tables incur write, storage and transfer dimensions; define RPO/RTO and Region need before replicating every object.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Track AI cross-Region inference transfer
points: Routing requests to another Region may change data transfer, latency, residency and capacity; diagram app Region, inference Region, response, and cache/batch choices.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Tag strategy creates ownership
points: Account, business unit, project and environment tags; activate cost allocation tags and cover missing/untagged spend. Diagram resource to billing line item to cost center.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Enforce tags at creation
points: Tag policies standardize permitted keys/values; SCP can constrain supported create actions with request tags; AWS Config detects drift. Distinguish prevention, standardization and detection.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Cost Explorer and detailed billing
points: Cost Explorer trends and grouped analysis; Cost and Usage Report/Data Exports line-item granularity for deeper attribution. Diagram management account billing data to analysis.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Cost Categories and split charges
points: Cost Categories map line items to business structure; split charge rules allocate shared costs in category views; show shared platform bill divided across teams.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Budget thresholds and anomalies
points: Budgets track planned threshold, Cost Anomaly Detection detects unusual spend relative to historical pattern. Separate planned overspend and unexpected deviation, then notify owner.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Walkthrough: investigate a cost spike
points: Step 1 Cost Explorer filter period/service/account; Step 2 isolate usage type and Region in detailed data; Step 3 inspect resource and recent change; Step 4 owner action and budget/anomaly guardrail.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: S3 tiering and lifecycle
points: Access frequency and recovery requirement drive S3 Intelligent-Tiering, storage class transitions and expiration. Show object age timeline and retrieval/monitoring tradeoffs.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: EBS and EFS storage economics
points: gp3 separates capacity and performance provisioning; gp2 performance relates to volume size; EFS lifecycle moves cold files to lower-cost tier. Diagram workload IOPS and file access age.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Database capacity is a workload decision
points: DynamoDB on-demand versus provisioned with auto scaling; RDS reserved DB instances for steady usage; Aurora Serverless for variable demand; Aurora I/O-Optimized when I/O pattern justifies. No universal cheapest.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Database Savings Plans and backup retention
points: Show eligible database commitment separately from DB capacity and backup retention. Retention, cross-Region backup copy and restore objectives shape storage charges.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Observe without collecting everything forever
points: Filter noisy logs at source, aggregate metrics, choose useful retention, archive selectively; trace troubleshooting requirement to collection and long-term storage.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Walkthrough: redesign an expensive architecture
points: Analyze baseline compute, cross-AZ traffic, NAT, storage and logs; revise via rightsizing, endpoints, tiering, retention; verify latency, resilience and full cost dimensions.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram

title: Cost decision table: preserve the constraint
points: Decision grid: variable demand -> elastic purchase; steady baseline -> commitment; retryable batch -> Spot; internet-heavy origin -> cache; shared services -> allocate; critical data -> recoverable retention. Footer cost is one of several architecture requirements.
layout: thin glass teaching pane and glossy service diagram
